includes: an anonymized trade export preserving the empirical pnl distribution
excludes: raw minute data and venue adapters
private ranked-event score thresholds and optimizer internals
live execution bridges and deployable account credentials

interpretation_rules: benchmark metrics are treated as a frozen reference, not a retuning target
recent windows are judged by expectancy bands and status flags rather than by best recent return
execution stress is modeled explicitly because short-hold futures systems are sensitive to degradation
public artifacts are meant for auditability and reuse, not as turnkey deployment code

why: The exclusion rule is the only tested policy at the 90-session anchor with a positive EV lower bound and zero_cross false.
Topstep lifecycle Monte Carlo remains positive under small extra cost stress (+$1 and +$2 per trade).
A broad 5% fill haircut materially weakens the profile, so execution quality still matters.
Cross-firm payout geometry looks best for MFFU Rapid and Lucid Pro on this same trade stream.
